QUOTE: | `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` | off (commented out) | `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` | ... | `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` | off (commented out) | `mbedtls_config.h:2196` |
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the threading config macros, and says that with THREADING_C off the mutex code compiles out. That makes THREADING_C a gate. For PTHREAD it says the "pthread backend is selected" when THREADING_C is on, so the pair is named as the gating macros.
